items.t: Oil sludge and engine failure
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report about $3,000–$4,800 for engine replacement.

items.t: Harsh, delayed or erratic shifting
items.job: Replace transmission solenoid/sensor, or rebuild transmission
items.note: Owners report about $2,000 on average when a rebuild is needed.

items.t: Automatic transmission failure
items.note: Owners report about $1,400 on average.

items.t: Stalling or no-start from a failed distributor sensor
items.note: Owners on CarComplaints report about $1,200 average for no-start repairs on the 1998, which can include other parts.

items.t: Failed emissions test
items.job: Replace oxygen sensor or catalytic converter
items.note: Owners report about $1,800 on average when a converter was needed.
